title: Obesity, the Philippines’ new malnutrition problem
summary: The trend points to a looming nutrition crisis. What changed?

blocks.text: The trend points to a looming nutrition crisis. What changed?
MANILA, Philippines – Filipinos have been dealing with obesity since the 1990s. In 2025, it reached its highest level yet and surpassed other forms of malnutrition.
The trend points to a looming nutrition crisis.
What changed? Rappler’s Eirene Manatlao explains. – Rappler.com
